target_moa.text: Deucravacitinib is a selective tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitor. It binds the pseudokinase (regulatory) domain of TYK2, stabilizing an autoinhibitory interaction with the catalytic domain, thereby inhibiting kinase activity and downstream STAT signaling; the exact mechanism in psoriasis is unknown.

citations.quote: SOTYKTU (deucravacitinib) tablets, for oral use is a small molecule that inhibits the tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) enzyme. TYK2 is a member of the Janus Kinase (JAK) family.

deucravacitinib binds to the pseudokinase domain of TYK2 and uniquely stabilizes an autoinhibitory interaction between the pseudokinase domain and the catalytic domain of the enzyme thereby inhibiting its kinase activity.
Deucravacitinib is a tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitor, which belongs to the Janus kinase family. The exact mechanism of action of deucravacitinib for the treatment of plaque psoriasis is unknown.

requirement.text: 4336-6 (Long-Term Safety): Randomized, active-controlled clinical trial to evaluate long-term safety of deucravacitinib in patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, characterizing cardiovascular adverse events, opportunistic infections, and malignancy.
